Alex: Quick heads-up — hotfix PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7842 needs 2x LGTM before today's merge cutoff at 21:00 UTC. I'm holding merge until we have two approvals. @Jordan @Maria @Sam can you take a look? :pray:
Jordan: On it. Quick question — one of the unit tests is failing locally for me (kv-cache-regress). Is that expected or is there a fix in the PR?
Alex: Good catch. That test was flaky; I pushed a small test harness tweak in the last commit (force-seed). CI passed on latest run except one unrelated e2e flake.
Maria: I'll review now, should be quick. If it's just the harness tweak I'm fine with an approval.
Sam: I can do a quick review but heads-up I'm OOO until ~20:30 UTC. If I can't get to it before cutoff, please don't block — merge only after 2x LGTM.
Jordan: Noted. Reviewing... leaving one nit about a log message but non-blocking.
Jordan: LGTM (non-blocking nit) :thumbsup:
Maria: Verified the fix locally and checked CI logs. Tests look green. One small comment about a comment wording, but not blocking. LGTM.
Alex: Thanks both! That gives us 2x LGTM. Will schedule merge at 21:00 unless anyone raises a blocker before then.
Sam: I can do a post-merge quick smoke after 20:45 if needed.
Alex: Great. release-bot, please schedule merge for PR #7842 at 21:00 UTC and hold if any new failing checks appear.
release-bot: @Alex — merge job scheduled for PR #7842 at 21:00 UTC. Will abort if required checks fail. (CI run id: 987654) :robot_face:
Alex: Copy. I'll monitor and post here after merge. Thanks everyone. :tada:
